{{Top|leg}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]] was the location of '''Imperial maintenance facilities''' during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] "acquired" several [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] from the facilities and installed them aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
